mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ld_knowledge_nodes (node_id, node_name, node_type, description, create_time) SELECT CONCAT('crop_', id), name, 'crop', description, NOW() FROM ld_crop_category

INSERT INTO ld_knowledge_nodes (node_id, node_name, node_type, parent_id, description, create_time) SELECT CONCAT('variety_', cv.id), cv.variety_name, 'variety', CONCAT('crop_', cv.category_id), CONCAT(COALESCE(cv.breeding_unit, '未知'), '选育，', COALESCE(cv.approval_year, ''), '年审定'), NOW() FROM ld_crop_variety cv WHERE cv.status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, variety_name, characteristics FROM ld_crop_variety WHERE status = 1 AND characteristics IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(node_id, 9) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM ld_knowledge_nodes WHERE node_id LIKE 'feature_%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ld_knowledge_nodes WHERE node_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ld_knowledge_nodes (node_id, node_name, node_type, parent_id, description, create_time) VALUES (#{nodeId}, #{nodeName}, 'feature', #{parentId}, #{description}, NOW())

INSERT INTO ld_knowledge_relations (source_node_id, target_node_id, relation_type, relation_label, create_time) SELECT CONCAT('crop_', cv.category_id), CONCAT('variety_', cv.id), '包含', '品种', NOW() FROM ld_crop_variety cv WHERE cv.status = 1

INSERT INTO ld_knowledge_relations (source_node_id, target_node_id, relation_type, relation_label, create_time) SELECT kn1.node_id, kn2.node_id, '具有', '特征', NOW() FROM ld_knowledge_nodes kn1 JOIN ld_knowledge_nodes kn2 ON kn1.node_id = kn2.parent_id WHERE kn1.node_type = 'variety' AND kn2.node_type = 'feature'
mapper.select: SELECT kn.node_id as id, kn.node_name as name, kn.node_type as type, kn.description, CASE WHEN kn.node_type = 'crop' THEN 3 WHEN kn.node_type = 'variety' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END as level, kn.parent_id FROM ld_knowledge_nodes kn WHERE kn.node_id = #{centerNode} OR kn.node_id = (SELECT parent_id FROM ld_knowledge_nodes WHERE node_id = #{centerNode})

SELECT kr.source_node_id as source, kr.target_node_id as target, kr.relation_type as type, kr.relation_label as label FROM ld_knowledge_relations kr WHERE kr.source_node_id = #{centerNode} OR kr.target_node_id = #{centerNode} OR kr.source_node_id IN (SELECT target_node_id FROM ld_knowledge_relations WHERE source_node_id = #{centerNode})

SELECT cv.id, cv.variety_name, cv.category_id, cc.name as crop_name FROM ld_crop_variety cv LEFT JOIN ld_crop_category cc ON cv.category_id = cc.id WHERE cv.variety_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND cv.status = 1 ORDER BY cv.variety_name LIMIT 10
SELECT cv.id, cv.variety_name, cv.category_id FROM ld_crop_variety cv WHERE cv.variety_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND cv.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT node_id as nodeId, node_name as nodeName, node_type as nodeType, description, CASE WHEN node_type = 'variety' THEN SUBSTRING(node_id, 9) ELSE NULL END as varietyId FROM ld_knowledge_nodes WHERE node_id = #{nodeId}
